text: Air France 145 is currently en route from Paris to London Heathrow. The aircraft is descending to 3,000 feet and requesting direct routing Tango Lima Alpha. Air Traffic Control is unable to grant the request due to conflicting traffic at 3,000 feet. Why did Air Traffic Control deny the request of Air France 145?
